name: qa-realtime-protocols
description: Real-time protocol testing: 3 skills (websocket-tests; server-sent-events-tests with k6 load testing in its references; mqtt-tests with STOMP/AMQP broker testing in its references) and 1 agent (realtime-protocol-reviewer). Anchored on RFC 6455, WHATWG SSE, and MQTT v5. gRPC streaming lives in qa-grpc; webhook testing lives in qa-notifications.
